answer: Bind every identity to one hardware haven: a device secure enclave issues one non-transferable attestation, and the network allows only one active identity per device. At dawn, a random sample must re-attest live in a short window, proving the same device still holds the key; silence or mismatch suspends privileges. A raven relay of gossip between independent nodes exposes duplicates when one key appears twice. An attacker wanting a thousand fakes must buy a thousand real devices and keep each online, while an honest user pays nothing beyond the phone they already own.
